record.original_question: In the polynomial tuning construction, does the resulting polynomial depend continuously on P2?

evidence.quote: Question 6. Does the resulting polynomial vary continuously with P2 ? This is true when P1 and P2 are quadratic [DH2].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup (polynomial tuning). Let $P_1:\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}$ be a monic polynomial of degree $d_1\geq 2$ with connected Julia set, and suppose $P_1$ has a superattracting periodic cycle of period $p\geq 2$ passing through a critical point. The filled Julia set $K(P_1)$ then contains a "little filled Julia set" $K'\subset K(P_1)$ associated to the renormalization of $P_1^p$ about this cycle: there exist topological disks $U'\Subset V'$ such that $P_1^p:U'\to V'$ is a polynomial-like map of some degree $d_2\geq 2$ with filled Julia set $K'$.

Let $P_2:\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}$ be any monic polynomial of degree $d_2$ with connected Julia set. The Douady–Hubbard tuning construction produces a new polynomial $P_1\perp P_2$ of degree $d_1$ (well-defined up to affine conjugacy) obtained, roughly, by replacing the dynamics of $P_1^p$ on the small filled Julia set $K'$ with a polynomial-like copy of $P_2$, and gluing this back into $P_1$ via the straightening theorem.

Question. Fix $P_1$ as above. Does the tuned polynomial $P_1\perp P_2$ depend continuously on $P_2$? More precisely, regarding $P_2$ as varying in the connectedness locus of monic centered polynomials of degree $d_2$, is the map $P_2\mapsto P_1\perp P_2$ (taking values in monic centered polynomials of degree $d_1$, modulo affine conjugacy) continuous?

(It is known that the answer is "yes" in the case where both $P_1$ and $P_2$ are quadratic.)
artifact.status_search_result: A search turned up the standard Douady–Hubbard framework for tuning and the parameter version of the straightening theorem (which gives continuity in the unicritical/quadratic-like setting), but no clear reference resolving continuous dependence of the tuned polynomial on $P_2$ in the general higher-degree case. Status appears unresolved in the general case.

status_evidence.title: Complex Dynamics and Renormalization (McMullen)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses tuning and straightening in the renormalization framework of Douady–Hubbard.
status_evidence.claim: Tuning continuity is established in quadratic-like cases via the parameter straightening theorem; no general result for higher degrees is cited.

status_evidence.title: Quadratic-Like Renormalisation in Holomorphic Dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: Parameter version of the Straightening Theorem applies to families of unicritical polynomial-like maps.
status_evidence.claim: Continuity of straightening, and hence of tuning, is established for unicritical (in particular quadratic) families.
